dose.frequency: once at headache onset; may repeat after at least 2 hours if partial response

regimens.dose_text: Single dose of 25 mg, 50 mg, or 100 mg taken at the onset of migraine attack. If the headache returns or only partially improves, a second dose may be administered at least 2 hours after the first dose. The maximum daily dose is 200 mg in a 24-hour period. In mild to moderate hepatic impairment, maximum single dose is 50 mg.
